GREGTHESPIRE-STEAL.description:
Play the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] if you have [gold]Energy[/gold] equal to or greater that its cost. 
If you don't have the [gold]Energy[/gold] to play the top card, place that card into your [gold]Stash[/gold]. 
Cards played this way wont [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. 
If your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] is empty you can't [gold]Steal[/gold].
